### [`figure_head_old_a`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_c940.asm#L6) `$C940-$C97F`

*data*

Unused block (pointer/part $25): a head, 12 pixels wide. It differs from the head at $d140 in 12 bits only, so one of the two is an older version. No table names $25 in the second set.
